title.en: The Old Stag: the story in brief

text.en:
Meena liked her new shoes but they hurt her feet.
"The thing I liked was not the best," she said.

This is a fable about a stag. He admires his big, beautiful antlers in a pool but is ashamed of his thin legs. When hunters chase him, his legs carry him quickly away, but his antlers get caught in the branches.
He then understands that the part he was proud of caused his trouble, and the part he disliked helped him most.
The lesson is that things that look beautiful are not always the most useful. This summary is based on the well-known story or poem and on public chapter notes. Please read the exact text in the textbook, because the textbook version may differ in details.

problem.en: Which part helps the stag escape?

text.en: The stag does not like his legs.
His legs help him run away.
